purpose: Resolve implementation-only aggregation semantics left implicit by the already-frozen Phase5 gates; no rule, threshold, asset, timeframe, cost, stop, target, hold or source change is introduced.

metric_semantics.calendar_year_expectancy: mean BASE net R of resolved trades grouped by UTC entry_time calendar year
metric_semantics.single_symbol_positive_net_r_share: for each symbol, sum(max(BASE net R,0)) over resolved trades for that symbol divided by sum(max(BASE net R,0)) over all resolved trades in the cell
metric_semantics.single_quarter_positive_net_r_share: for each UTC entry_time calendar quarter, sum(max(BASE net R,0)) over resolved trades in that quarter divided by sum(max(BASE net R,0)) over all resolved trades in the cell
metric_semantics.concentration_denominator_zero: gate fails closed if total positive BASE net R is zero
metric_semantics.bootstrap: UTC_ENTRY_DAY_BLOCK; 5000 repetitions; seed 230911; 95 percent interval; identical to Phase4
metric_semantics.primary_decision: DH-02-HO1 only; DH-03-HO1 is reported jointly and cannot rescue a DH-02-HO1 failure
